labels.titleRequired: Task title is required. Example: ag + Prepare deck @today p:high +work
labels.selectorRequired: Task number or keyword is required. Example: ag ok 1
labels.searchRequired: Search keyword is required. Example: ag find invoice
labels.helpHint: Run "ag help" (command help: "ag <cmd> --help", all: "ag help all") for usage.
labels.shortHelp:
Agendamea CLI v{version} (aliases: ag | agenda | agendamea)

Daily Short Commands (shell-safe in PowerShell, CMD & Bash):
  ag                                 List active tasks as #1 [id]
  ag + Prepare deck @today p:high +work c:"Personal" 14.30
                                     Add a task (@tomorrow, @fri, +3d, +1m, @morning, i:, pin:)
  ag show 1                          View full task details (notes + subtasks)
  ag ok 1                            Complete task #1 (or short ID / keyword)
  ag rm 2                            Move task #2 to Trash
  ag find invoice                    Search titles, notes, subtasks, and #tags
  ag undo                            Restore last deleted item from Trash
  ag stat                            Show summary

Automation, MCP & System:
  ag mcp [list|install <client>|doctor] 23-tool MCP server + one-click client installer
  ag serve [start|stop|status]       Headless local API + Incoming Webhook + HTTP MCP server
  ag hook [set|events|logs|outbox|replay|test] Webhooks, delivery logs, outbox queue & replay
  ag ai [status|models|download|delete] Local AI hardware profile and model manager
  ag ask "<command/question>" [--yes] Natural language assistant (interactive confirm)
  ag rag "<query>"                   Chunked hybrid FTS5 + vector RAG search
  ag completion [powershell|bash|zsh] [--install] Auto-install shell tab completion (PS 5.1 + PS 7)
  ag doctor                          PATH, SQLite, server, MCP & Webhook health check
  ag help [cmd|all]                  Per-command help or complete command reference
labels.fullHelp:
Agendamea CLI v{version} - 100% Headless Full Control

TASKS:
  ag [today|imp|done|/Category]      List tasks (--from, --to, --tag, --priority, --sort)
  ag + <title> [@today|@tomorrow|@fri|+3d|+1m|@s..e] [14.30|@morning] [p:high|p:low] [i:] [pin:] [+tag] [c:"Cat"] [--note ".."] [--sub ".."] [-- raw title]
  ag + -                             Batch-add tasks line-by-line from stdin pipe (quote-aware)
  ag show <1|shortId|keyword>        Full task detail view with notes & subtasks
  ag edit <1|keyword|id> [fields]    Edit (--title --note --due --start --time --priority --cat --tags)
  ag ok <1|1 2 3|shortId|keyword>    Complete / reopen single or multiple tasks
  ag pin <1|1 2|shortId|keyword>     Pin / unpin single or multiple tasks
  ag move <1|keyword|id> <pos>       Move a task to a 1-based position
  ag rm <1|1 2 3|shortId|keyword>    Move single or multiple tasks to Trash
  ag find <keyword> [--from --to]    Search titles, notes, subtasks, and #tags
  ag clear-done [Category]           Move completed tasks to Trash

VIEWS (CALENDAR, KANBAN, MATRIX):
  ag cal [--from --to]               Chronological calendar agenda (numbered 1..N)
  ag kanban [priority|status]        Kanban columns by priority or status (numbered 1..N)
  ag matrix                          Eisenhower 4-quadrant overview (numbered 1..N)

SUBTASKS:
  ag sub <task>                      List subtasks for a task
  ag sub <task> + <title>            Add a subtask
  ag sub <task> ok <1|keyword>       Toggle a subtask complete
  ag sub <task> edit <1|key> <title> Rename a subtask
  ag sub <task> rm <1|keyword>       Delete a subtask

CATEGORIES:
  ag cat                             List categories with active task counts
  ag cat + <name> [#hex]             Create a category
  ag cat edit <1|name> [--name ..] [--color #..] [--pin]
  ag cat move <1|name> <pos>         Move category to a 1-based position
  ag cat rm <1|name>                 Move category to Trash

TRASH:
  ag trash [-q word] [--from --to]   List / filter trashed tasks & categories
  ag undo [1|keyword]                Restore last (or matching) item from Trash
  ag trash delete <1|keyword>        Permanently delete a trashed item
  ag trash empty --yes               Empty entire Trash

BACKUP, CLOUD, SERVER, WEBHOOKS, SETTINGS & MCP:
  ag export [backup.json]            Export JSON backup
  ag import <backup.json|->          Atomically restore JSON backup from file or stdin
  ag sync [auto|status|set <dir>|pull|off] Cloud folder sync & provider auto-detection
  ag reset --yes [--all]             Clear all data (--all resets preferences too)
  ag config [key value|--list]       Inspect/update any preference
  ag serve [start|stop|status] [--port N] [--fg] Headless API, Incoming Webhook & HTTP MCP server
  ag hook [set|events|logs|outbox|replay|test|on|off] Webhooks, delivery logs & outbox queue
  ag mcp [list|install <client>|uninstall <client>|doctor] 23-tool MCP server & auto-installer
  ag completion [powershell|bash|zsh] [--install] Shell tab completion (Windows PS 5.1 + PS 7)
  ag doctor                          PATH, SQLite, server, MCP & Webhook health check
  ag install / ag uninstall          Zero-GUI PATH installation & removal
  ag update                          Check GitHub Releases for updates
  -j, --json | --no-color | --quiet  Raw JSON, plain text, or quiet output flags
